name: Albertirsa (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of light blue over yellow, charged at the centre of the light blue with the town arms of Albertirsa (a blue and white shield with a crown, a plough and ears of grain) and in the yellow with the name ALBERTIRSA in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
